payload.reason: The evidence provides specific previously reported results related to speculation detection and scope resolution using various models, including improvements in F1 scores.

claims.text: Substantial improvements were reported over previously reported results by at least 0.29 F1 points on cue detection and 4.27 F1 points on scope resolution.
XLNet consistently outperformed BERT and RoBERTa, contrary to results on other benchmark datasets, particularly in negation detection and scope resolution.
